subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Mixed collection of generic runtime helper objects: edit/list UI controls, a CUBE scene loader, indexed linked-list collections, OSC script engine initialization, a surface-resource manager with MAS-audio shutdown, text-element render/measure/buffer helpers, multi-stage resource cleanup, path-string access, session lifecycle controllers, and small UI-render/global-state dispatch helpers.

summary: Derived architecture proposal for 26 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects. Owners are UNKNOWN in the packet for all but 0x0049D150 (HudOverlayManager, GUESS), so every class below is a GUESS grouping anchored on shared this-offset field layouts. Two classes are anchored by common field bases evidenced across multiple methods: ResourceManager owns the surface-resource registry (list head this+0x104, counter this+0x108) shared by 0x004963D0 and 0x00497AD0, and UITextElement owns the text buffer at byte offset this+5400 shared by 0x004981F0, 0x004983B0 and 0x00498560 (source:raw only; no field ref exists for 0x1518). The packet is deliberately left heterogeneous: small forwarding/accessor helpers (0x00494A30, 0x00495150, 0x00498030, 0x0048FEC0) are grouped at interface level only, and offsets 0xF0/0xF8/0xFC appear in both LinkedListCollection and ResourceManager without proven common ownership, so per rule 8 they are kept as separate classes.

function_roles.role: Replace the edit control's text buffer with a2: null and no-change guards return -1; bounded copy via sub_587DD0, forced NUL terminator, truncation at the first validator-rejected char via sub_48B560, cursor reset to buffer start then advanced to the string end, vtable render-update call; returns 0.
Guarded accessor returning this+0x338 when this+0x328 > 0, else -1; interpreted (not packet-proven) as list item count and selected index.

CUBE scene load entry: resolve directory path (this[56] or byte_5EA438), reject via sub_588410, traverse the child list, init audio via sub_546010; on failure set fallback via SimpleGetter_5020 and dispatch UtilityFunction_1cd0 + sub_541CA0; on success relocate strings and report load errors; returns 1/0.

Indexed accessor returning the data pointer of the node at this+0x174: validates the index against the count at this+0xFC, walks from the head this+0xF0 via next-at-+4, returns the matched node's first dword or 0.
Dispatch the vtable method pointer at byte offset 0x40 with this and the flag at this[56]; then call UIWindowTypeDetection(this); returns 0. Part of a UI component update path.
Write four __int16 arguments into this+0/+2/+4/+6; return the value stored into the third field. Structural twin of RectangleClampConstraint (0x00491600).

Initialize and run the OSC script engine: null-guard on a2, copy the script name into this+0xC, store parser flags at 0x198/0x199/0x19A and script data at 0x1A4, open file streams, run the parsers, conditionally load media (eas.bik / legal.bmp / eaintro.bik), then clean up.
__stdcall forwarder: ignore a1, forward a2..a10 unchanged to ClippedRenderRegion (0x00543250) and return its result; used by scrollbar/scroll-view/text-box/text-input/blit render paths.
Thin forwarder passing a1 to PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval and returning its result; closes a MAS audio handle during resource shutdown.
Parameterless accessor returning global dword_7CDE14 unchanged; shared UI render/draw-state flag or cursor used across render and resource-load paths.

Global resource manager teardown: walk four managed lists invoking virtual destructors/release thunks and freeing nodes, zero the list heads, free collision geometry, release this[43]/this[44] resources, clean cursor resources, and close the MAS audio list.

Load and register a surface resource by name: reject null, check the cache via sub_497BA0, resolve the ID via HashTableIDResolution, format/report a load error, allocate a 20-byte node (flag 1 at +0, +8=-1, ID at +12, next at +16), append it to the this+0x104 list, increment this+0x108, return the node.

Configure alpha-blend state: when renderer a1 is non-null, copy flt_7CF2CC into dword_5CC9E0, clamp to [0,1], zero a 12-byte scratch array, dispatch vtable entry 4 with six args; the null-a1 path returns an uninitialized value.

Render a text UI element at a horizontally/vertically computed position inside a bounding rectangle: null a2 returns -1; skip when this+5400 is empty; optionally resolve a2 via the string table (sub_423A00 into byte_5EC4CC), measure via sub_494F00, position via a3/a4 centering, dispatch via UIMessageDispatch with the GlobalAccessor_5150 value.
Measure the rendered text width/height into a3/a4: zero the outputs, null a2 returns -1, measure only when the this+5400 buffer is non-empty, optionally resolve a2 through the string table.

Copy a non-empty input string (<=63 chars) into a stack buffer, NUL-terminate, run the string-keyed lookup sub_566810 against dword_5CC79C clearing the first byte of any hit, then strcpy the sanitized buffer into this+5400.

Conditionally clean two resource fields: release/cascade-clean this+0x30 via sub_5539F0 and clear it; independently, if this+0x2C is non-zero, invoke an object-level cleanup routine; returns the this+0x30 cleanup outcome.
Return the path string pointer at this+0x10, falling back to global byte_5EA438 when null; used by resource/session path lookup callers.

__thiscall forwarder calling StoreFourShorts (0x004916E0) with the receiver advanced by 18 word elements and four zero arguments, returning the __int16 result; acts as a subsystem initialization shim.
Trivial boolean query: dereference dword_7C54E0, read the dword at offset 16484, return whether it equals 3; queried by three callers as a session disqualification/state flag.

Multi-stage overlay teardown: release sub-resources at 0x18/0x1C and list pointers at 0x4/0x8/0xC when non-null, run the four-phase cleanup sequence on five sub-blocks, zero the byte flag at 0x0 and dwords 0x4..0x5C; returns 0.
Release the resource pointer at this[2] (this+0x8): destructor sub_5502C0, stub sub_557470, free wrapper sub_587BCF, then clear the field; returns the last operation result.

Post-loading session/scene init orchestrator: hide the cursor, conditionally load the FIA short BIK (championship mode 4 + session type 7 + timer flag), chain subsystem setup (module dispatch, global resets, camera viewport, current-vehicle binding, game-state/audio dispatch), then scene/camera/collision/telemetry gated on ScoringGateCheck; returns the BIK load result.

Post-race session transition: clean the D3D resource list, show the cursor, and for race session (7) with championship mode != 6 probe the post-race monitor state and build/dispatch it or set the session-flag path; then tear down resources, advance global state, gate-teardown, per-vehicle state dispatch, and the session dispatch chain; returns 0.

Initialize session-wide state: reset the sound system via a vtable method, init a buffer, run a sub-initializer with 4, set the session init flag, set a scoring-gate flag from dword_7D0038, init an array-check structure, and place multiplayer vehicles from tire-wear data; returns 0.

Conditionally load/display classification screen data: when DelegatedFieldGetter returns 3, list deref yields a non-null vehicle node, and FixedOffsetReturn is truthy, resolve the scene name and load the winconstructor file when PathFileComparisonCounter == 1 and dword_7D032C == 1; always calls ScoringClassificationDisplay; returns 0.

classes.name: SessionController
classes.responsibility: Session lifecycle controller driving global session state (session manager object dword_5EA510, session type dword_7C56A4, championship mode dword_7D0410, active-vehicle array dword_7C54F0): session init (0x004A06E0), post-loading scene init (0x004A00A0), post-race transition (0x004A0250), classification-screen load (0x004A08E0), and a disqualification query (0x0049BAB0). These are global-orchestrator functions rather than instance methods; the class is a behavioral grouping, not an object layout.

compatibility_contracts.name: EditBufferLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: UITextEditControl stores its text buffer at this+0x2F0, the cursor pointer at this+0x2F4 and a buffer end-limit at this+0x2F8; EditBufferStringReplace copies at most this[190]-1 bytes, always writes a NUL at v4[end-1], filters characters via the field-type validator sub_48B560, then repositions the cursor at the string end and requests a render update through vtable+44. A replacement must preserve this layout and the field-type filtering.

compatibility_contracts.name: LinkedListNodeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: List nodes are records with the data pointer at +0 and the next pointer at +4; LinkedListIndexedAccessor (0x0048F590) validates its index against the count at this+0xFC, walks from the head at this+0xF0 via the +4 next links, and returns the matched node's first dword or 0. A replacement must preserve this node stride.

compatibility_contracts.name: SurfaceResourceNodeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Surface-registration nodes are 20 bytes: flag byte 1 at +0, +4 cleared, +8 preset to -1, resolved string ID at +12, next link at +16; they are appended to the singly-linked list rooted at this+0x104 (walking the +16 next links to the tail) while the counter at this+0x108 is incremented. A replacement must preserve the node size and the list head/counter offsets.

compatibility_contracts.name: TextBufferAt5400
compatibility_contracts.description: The text UI element stores its message buffer at byte offset this+5400 (0x1518); render (0x004981F0), measure (0x004983B0) and buffer-replace (0x00498560) all key off this buffer, with optional string-table resolution through byte_5EC4C0/byte_5EC4CC via sub_423A00 and lookup sub_566810 against dword_5CC79C. The offset is evidenced only by source:raw.

compatibility_contracts.name: MASAudioListLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: ResourceManager's MAS audio list is rooted at this+0xF0 with the iterator start copied from this[60] into this[62] (0xF8) and end at this+0xFC; nodes hold the MAS handle at +8 and the next pointer at +4; each node is closed via MASCloseWrapper (0x00495010) during shutdown. A replacement must preserve the node offsets.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionStateGlobals
compatibility_contracts.description: Session lifecycle code drives global state through the session manager object dword_5EA510, session type dword_7C56A4 (7 = race), championship mode dword_7D0410 (4 = championship intro, 6 = excluded from post-race monitor path), intro/timer flag dword_7D032C, the active-vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 with index dword_7C54E4, and the scoring gate sub_42BC10. A replacement must keep these global anchors and value conventions.

compatibility_contracts.name: CUBESceneLoadContract
compatibility_contracts.description: CUBESceneLoaderEntry resolves a directory path (this[56] or byte_5EA438), rejects invalid paths via sub_588410, traverses the child list at this[16], and initializes audio via AudioEngineInitialization(this+58, path, 0); on failure it stores SimpleGetter_5020() into this[59] and dispatches UtilityFunction_1cd0(0,0,0.0,0,0,0) + sub_541CA0(0).
